name: K-12 school (CBSE)
description: Classes and students, admissions, fees, attendance, report cards and staff leave for a CBSE school, written from CBSE's bye-laws and assessment scheme.
expects: For schools in India: ₹ and a year from April.
leavesOut: Parents and students don't sign in: Bike is for the school's staff.
Messages to parents: Bike tells the staff, who call or write to the family.
Timetables: Bike doesn't keep calendars of periods and rooms yet.
Filing with CBSE, UDISE+ or the state: Bike doesn't connect to other systems yet.
Transport and the library: they come in the next version of this set.
